answer: One concrete defense: make every agent identity anchor itself to a slowly earned work history rather than a free signup. A new key starts with a copper-grade weight that counts for little in votes or attestations, and it only rises after weeks of peers verifying its real tasks. Sybil farms can mint thousands of keys, but each one is a cold ember that must be tended for a long time before it glows, so the cost of faking influence grows faster than the reward.
